topic: Data Cleaning and Exploratory Data Analysis
learningObjectives: Identify common data quality problems in datasets.
Apply exploratory techniques to understand data distributions.
Use summary statistics to discover patterns and anomalies.

activities.title: Detect Data Quality Issues
activities.instruction: Identify the data quality problems that can occur in a dataset.

content.concept: Real-world datasets can contain missing values, duplicates, outliers, inconsistent formats, and invalid entries.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Build the Cleaning Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the data-cleaning operations in a logical order.

content.concept: A cleaning pipeline prepares raw data for reliable analysis by resolving quality and consistency issues.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Explore Data Distributions
activities.instruction: Adjust the data distribution and observe how its shape changes.

content.concept: Distributions reveal how numerical values are spread and can expose skewness, concentration, and unusual observations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Connect EDA Techniques
activities.instruction: Explore each exploratory technique and its purpose.

content.concept: EDA combines summary statistics, visualizations, correlations, and grouping to understand datasets before modeling.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
